text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City won the Japan Cup. She 
declared that she would win the Arima 
Kinen as well to prove she's the strongest 
of all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S entered the race this time 
with a conscious desire to serve as an 
"ordeal" for others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a result, she was convinced that Tap 
Dance City's fire had stoked in order to 
defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next, to set the entire era ablaze. Aiming 
to become an “ordeal” for the Umamusume 
running today— she targets the pinnacle at 
the "Arima Kinen."
